messages:
jules (docs): Quick flag: API ref for POST /v1/generate shows enum values as `FULL`/`PARTIAL` but our quickstart sends `full`. A customer reported a 400 following the quickstart. I opened a docs PR to reconcile: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9122

hao (runtime): Can you paste the failing body? I want to confirm behaviour before docs change.

jules (docs): From the customer: `{"prompt":"hello","response_type":"full"}` -> 400 `invalid enum value`.

link-bot: docs-bot: PR 9122 opened by jules 1 reviewers: maya, rachel 1 https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9122

maya (devex): Also noticed the API ref error example is flat `{"message":"..."}` but SDKs unwrap `error.message`. We should show the canonical wrapped form and a deprecated flat variant.

rachel (sdk): On SDKs I can make error parsing tolerant (`resp.error?.message || resp.message`). I'll also update Python/JS snippets to use lowercase `full` and add a small test.

hao (runtime): I'll open a runtime PR to accept enums case-insensitively and normalize to lowercase so examples match. I'll include a unit test.

maya (devex): Small doc nits: update Go example comment for ResponseType consts and add a changelog bullet.

jules (docs): Updated PR 9122: canonical examples now use `full` (lowercase), compatibility note added: "server accepts `full` or `FULL`", and error examples include both wrapped and flat shapes with deprecation note. CI lint and link-check ran.

link-bot: ci-bot: link-check failed (old snippet link).

rachel (sdk): Fixed snippet link and pushed SDK tests. CI green.

hao (runtime): Runtime PR 634 opened and tests pass locally: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/634. Waiting on CI.

jules (docs): Will merge docs PR after runtime CI is green so live behavior matches docs. Thanks all!
